text: IDEXX tests are on the bill like any other charge. What's different is that the doctor can add tests inside IDEXX, and Scout keeps the bill in step.
Remember: tests the doctor adds in IDEXX are charged by Scout. Don't add them by hand.
Juniper Rivera's bill has a CBC sent to IDEXX.
The status says where the test is: Not sent, Finish in IDEXX, Not at IDEXX yet, Partial or Final.
Dr. Lane added a urinalysis inside IDEXX. Scout charged it here, at the family's price, and tagged it Added in IDEXX.
If Scout can't charge a test, for example when the bill is already paid, Billing gets a task naming the test and the family.
If the doctor drops a test, removing its charge also cancels it at IDEXX, as long as IDEXX doesn't have the sample yet.
The most common mistake: adding an IDEXX add-on by hand, so it's charged twice. Remember: tests the doctor adds in IDEXX are charged by Scout.
